text:
maria: CI is failing on the schema-contract check for keystore events - looks like a breaking change from the RBAC rollout. hit our customer-facing audit validation
ajay: which test? can you paste the failure?
maria: test output: 
```
FAILED tests/audit_schema/test_keystore_events.py::test_event_contract
- expected field 'actor_identity' in audit.keystore.rotate
- got null
Trace: AssertionError: Missing required property 'actor_identity'
```
maria: this started after #4289 (rbac/authz) merged yesterday, suspect the new internal service principal produced events without actor_identity
sec-bot: CI summary: schema-contract-check job failed on 3/3 runners, regressed at build 1725550000. Artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/artifacts/1725550001/keystore-schema-fail.log
leo: likely golden-fixture mismatch. the golden includes actor_identity for backwards compat, but new producer omitted it. options: (1) transform producer to include actor_identity, (2) make validator tolerant, (3) transform ingestion to backfill.
dana: preference is to keep customer-facing audit events stable. we should not loosen schema for external events without a deprecation plan. ingestion transform + backfill sounds safest. also loop in compliance — they need to know about missing principal data for audits. @maria can you escalate? :exclamation:
ajay: agree with dana. quick fix while we patch producer: update JSON schema to accept either object with actor_identity OR explicit null via anyOf, then run ci. example schema patch:
```json
"keystore.rotate": {
  "anyOf": [
    {"required": ["actor_identity", "timestamp", "resource_id"]},
    {"required": ["timestamp", "resource_id"], "properties": {"actor_identity": {"type": ["null", "string"]}}}
  ]
}
```
ajay: that buys us time but we should still do ingestion transformation within 48h
maria: opening an incident ticket and pinging the author of #4289 now. raising a short-lived tolerant schema sounds ok but we must set a clear deadline to revert. ticket #INC-793 created, tagging compliance and SRE
leo: i'll run golden fixture regen and CI locally, will push a PR with the transformation code (ingest-normalizer) + tests. command I'll run: 
```
./scripts/regenerate_golden.sh keystore.rotate && pytest tests/audit_schema -k keystore -q
```
dana: also notify customers on the compliance org slack and add a migration task to the Private deployment checklist. i'll draft a brief with timeline and what to expect.
maria: owner list: ajay -> schema short-term PR; leo -> ingest transform + golden regen; dana -> compliance comms; maria -> canary run and rollback plan. aim to have PRs by EOD and rollout canary to prod-noncritical region tomorrow. :thumbsup:
ajay: opening PR now -> #4331. adding schema tests and a CI-only flag to auto-reject if tolerant schema persists beyond 7 days.
leo: pushed draft PR for ingress transform -> #4332, running CI but expecting one flaky test, will iterate.
maria: thanks team. if anyone sees customer queries, redirect to dana's doc. will post status updates here.
sec-bot: Reminder: mark incident INC-793 as P2 and add postmortem template link: https://redwood.internal/incident-postmortem
